# First-run startup opens Hub through the shared predicate and an unconditional setup helper

The startup patch replaces legacy account-count logic with isFirstRun and removes the initial-setup/Hub-pref gate from openAccountSetup. The original startup caller uses its Boolean return to decide when to load the normal Mail UI; accepted code later changes that return flow. The helper focuses the main window and invokes Hub, whose modal still opens asynchronously. A dedicated test waits for dialog/form visibility, while the existing-account negative check waits 1,000 ms. Keep these direct assertions, predicate data-source conditions and later startup phases distinct from a completed startup or indefinite absence result.

Scope: Account Hub first-run startup integration.
